title: Stand Up! Stand Up for Jesus!

sections.name: Verse 1
lines: [Ab]Stand up, stand up for Jesus!
[Ab]Ye soldiers of the [Gdim]cross;
[Ab]Lift high His [Gdim]royal banner,
[Cm/G]It [Ab]must not suffer loss:
[Ab]From victory unto [Gdim]victory,
[Eb]His army shall Helead,
[Gdim]Till every [Ab]foe [Db/Ab]is [Ab]vanquished,
[Bbm/Db]And Christ [Fm/C]is Lord [Eb/Bb]indeed.

sections.name: Verse 2
lines: [Ab]Stand up, stand up for Jesus! The trumpet call obey:
[Ab]Forth to the mighty conflict, [Gdim]in this His glorious day;
[Eb]Ye that are men now serve Him against unnumbered [Fm]foes;
[Bbm/Db]Let courage rise with [Fm/C]danger, and strength [Eb/Bb]to strength oppose.

sections.name: Verse 3
lines: [Ab]Stand up, stand up for Jesus! Stand in His strength alone,
[Ab]The arm of flesh will fail you, [Gdim]ye dare not trust your own;
[Eb]Put on the gospel armor, and watching [Fm]unto prayer,
[Bbm/Db]Where calls the voice of [Fm/C]duty, be never [Eb/Bb]wanting there.

sections.name: Verse 4
lines: [Ab]Stand up, stand up for Jesus! the strife will not be [Db/Ab]long;
[Ab]This day the noise of battle, [Gdim]the next the victor's song;
[Eb]To him that overcometh a crown of [Fm]life shall be;
[Bbm/Db]He with the King of [Fm/C]glory shall reign [Eb/Bb]eternally.
